title: Next Permutation
summary: Rearrange the array into the next larger arrangement in dictionary order: find the pivot where the descending tail begins, swap it with the next larger value, and reverse the tail.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Array values
inputs.note: Duplicates are allowed. The array is rearranged in place; the largest arrangement wraps to the smallest.

anchors.label: Start the pivot search at the second-to-last value
Scan left for a value smaller than its right neighbour
Find the smallest larger value to the right
